::: {.stats-intro}

An overview of my reading activity, from individual reading sessions to longer-term trends.

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source("R/localization_helpers.R")
source("R/reading_helpers.R")
source("R/statistics_helpers.R")

stats <- prepare_statistics()

lang <- "en"
```

## Reading Habits

:::: {.stats-average-grid}

::: {.stats-average-card}

### `{r} m_number(stats$reading_days, lang)`

Days with logged reading

:::

::: {.stats-average-card}

### `{r} m_number(stats$average_daily, lang)`

Avg. pages per calendar day

:::

::: {.stats-average-card}

### `{r} m_number(stats$average_reading_day, lang)`

Avg. pages per reading day

:::

::::

::: {.stats-note}

Daily averages are calculated from the first to the latest recorded reading date. Dates without entries are treated as zero for these calculations, although an unlogged day does not necessarily mean no reading occurred.

Completed-book page counts and daily page logs are separate measures and should not be added together.

:::

## Recent Reading Activity

Pages recorded each day within the most recent 30 days of available reading history.

::: {.stats-chart .stats-chart--light}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 3.3
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "Daily pages logged during the most recent available reading period."

show_stats_plot(
  plot_daily_reading(stats, lang, dark = FALSE),
  lang
)
```

:::

::: {.stats-chart .stats-chart--dark}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 3.3
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "Daily pages logged during the most recent available reading period."

show_stats_plot(
  plot_daily_reading(stats, lang, dark = TRUE),
  lang
)
```

:::

## Monthly Reading

Total pages recorded in daily reading logs each month, covering up to the most recent twelve months in the dataset.

::: {.stats-chart .stats-chart--light}

```{r}

#| warning: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 3.3
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-alt: "Monthly totals of pages recorded through daily reading logs."

  plot_monthly_reading(stats, lang, dark = FALSE),
  lang
)
```

:::
